economic_hypothesis: In a PIT board-and-industry bull state, a high-turnover demand bar creates an observable launch price and prior high. The first low-turnover deep test that closes back above the launch price is tradable only when the frozen prior high leaves enough executable net room. The launch price is both the support premise and the failure boundary; the prior high is the first real supply target.
bull_state: board60 > 0, board breadth60 >= 0.50, board120 > 0, board breadth120 >= 0.45; industry20 and industry60 > 0, industry breadth20 and breadth60 >= 0.50; all known at signal close

first_supply_test.signal_close: at or above launch price and no higher than 1.02 times anchor VWAP

execution.entry: first legal open after completed signal, within three calendar sessions
execution.target: frozen anchor coordinate high, realizable no earlier than T+1
execution.failure: completed close below frozen launch price, then next legal open

governance.post_2023_rows: only legal resolution of a pre-2024 trade
